g.text: Linear viscous-damped SDOF model with harmonic applied force. Curves are steady-state amplitudes after the transient decays; F0/k is static deflection.
Resonant amplification depends on damping. Zero-damping resonance has no bounded steady-state amplitude and is not included. Phase lag, initial response,
